# Naturo Group — robots policy
# Sitemap is generated by @astrojs/sitemap.

User-agent: *
Allow: /

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# AI SEARCH crawlers — ALLOWED.
#
# These fetch pages so an AI assistant can CITE us in an answer. They are a
# discovery channel, not a training scrape: blocking them removes Naturo from
# Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT Search, Perplexity and Claude while competitors
# stay visible. Cited brands earn materially more clicks than uncited ones.
#
# Google-Extended in particular gates AI Overviews, which now appear on
# roughly half of all Google queries.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
User-agent: Google-Extended
Allow: /

User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
Allow: /

User-agent: ChatGPT-User
Allow: /

User-agent: PerplexityBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Perplexity-User
Allow: /

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Claude-User
Allow: /

User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Bingbot
Allow: /

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# TRAINING-DATA scrapers — BLOCKED.
#
# These harvest copy for model training and send no traffic back. Blocking
# them costs us no search visibility. Remove a line only if we decide we
# want our marketing copy in that corpus.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: CCBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: anthropic-ai
Disallow: /

User-agent: Amazonbot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Bytespider
Disallow: /

User-agent: Meta-ExternalAgent
Disallow: /

# Sitemap — emitted by the @astrojs/sitemap integration at build time.
Sitemap: https://naturogroup.com.au/sitemap-index.xml
